faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Questions agents ask before they switch.

items.a: Agency plans start with a 7-day free trial. The Agent plan is US$ 10 a month.

items.q: Can I bring in the sales I already have in Excel?
items.a: Yes. Upload your file, confirm which column is which, and review the rows before saving. Venselo matches hotels and suppliers and skips any reservation ID already in your account. You can also use a file to update existing reservations.

items.q: Which deadlines does Venselo remind me about?
items.a: Final payments for Disney packages, Disney Cruise Line and Universal, online check-in for cruises, restaurant reservations and Lightning Lane. Each sale gets the alerts that apply to its product. You can add custom alerts for anything else.

items.q: What happens if my client pays early?
items.a: Record the payment on the sale. Once the total paid reaches the full amount, the final payment reminder stops.

items.q: Can I see my deadlines in Google Calendar?
items.a: Yes. Subscribe to your alerts from Google Calendar, Apple Calendar or Outlook. Deadlines show as all-day events and update on their own.

items.q: Who counts toward an agency plan's agent limit?
items.a: Only agents. Managers are unlimited and never count. If you grow past your plan, move up to the next one: 10, 30, 60 or unlimited agents.

items.q: Is Venselo available in Spanish and English?
items.a: Yes. Every screen and every alert email is in both languages, and each person picks their own.
Yearly agency plans cost the same as 10 months, so you get 2 months free. The Agent plan is monthly only. Payments are handled by Lemon Squeezy, and you can change or cancel your plan from Settings.
